name: Festival Stone of Dawnsong
title: Festival Stone of Dawnsong
summary: The Festival Stone at the southern tip of a narrow 120 m sea-cliff ridge by the Southern Landbridge (89.2S 43.8W), flanked by two candle statues with its glow above; the ridge runs north at z 120 above a 68 m shelf, and the southern ocean opens below.

landmarks.name: Festival Stone
landmarks.note: Anniversary Effect at z 128; statues 0x02000397 at (13951.5,3052.9) and (13960.2,3052.2).

shots.standingOrder: Climb round the south side of the Festival Stone on the cliff tip, 28 to 50 m out over the ocean, sun behind; never over the ridge to its north.
shots.notes: Signature helix around the Festival Stone at the tip of the 120 m sea cliff: radius 28 -> 50 m, 4 -> 22 m above it, swinging from south-south-east to south over the 68 m shelf and the ocean, the stone, its two candle statues and its glow against the sky, sun behind.
